title: Lysergsäure-diäthylamid, ein Phantastikum aus der Mutterkorngruppe
shortTitle: LSD, a Phantasticum from the Ergot Group
author: Werner A. Stoll
summary: Werner Stoll's first systematic clinical study of LSD, examining sixteen healthy volunteers and six schizophrenic patients, plus Stoll's own self-experiment. Published in 1947 following Hofmann's 1943 discovery at Sandoz, it established key vocabulary for psychiatric LSD research.
citation: Werner A. Stoll, "Lysergsäure-diäthylamid, ein Phantastikum aus der Mutterkorngruppe," Schweizer Archiv für Neurologie und Psychiatrie 60 (1947): 279–323.
rights: In copyright (Switzerland; author d. 1969). No US Government interest.
